topics.title: Topics
topics.hint: Manage major topics and subtopics. Hidden topics are removed from the portal and the topic list when writing.

create.label: Add topic
create.slugHint: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens for the address; it can't be changed later. Colors use #RRGGBB.

topics.recentPosts_one: {{count, number}} post in the last 30 days
topics.recentPosts_other: {{count, number}} posts in the last 30 days

curations.title: Portal picks
curations.hint: Choose posts for the operator picks on the portal home for a set period. Up to 5 picks can overlap in time.
curations.ineligible: No longer meets the portal conditions, so it isn't shown now.

exclusions.title: Portal exclusions
exclusions.hint: Excluded posts are removed only from the portal home and topic pages. They stay on the blog, in search and in feeds.

settings.title: Portal settings
settings.hint: Changes apply from the next portal request.

score-weights.title: Popularity score weights
score-weights.hint: Weights for views, reads to the end, likes and comments (0–1000), half-life (1–720 hours) and report penalty (0–1).

new-member-delay.title: New member waiting time
new-member-delay.hint: Posts appear on the portal only after this much time since sign-up (0–720 hours).

min-content-length.title: Minimum body length
min-content-length.hint: Posts with a body shorter than this many characters don't appear on the portal (0–10000).

topic-auto-hide-threshold.title: Topic auto-hide threshold
topic-auto-hide-threshold.hint: Major topics with fewer posts than this in the last 30 days are removed from the topic tabs (0–1000).
